About the author

Kenny Wayne is a veteran, a husband and the father of three, a son and twin daughters. He lives with his family in the southern United States, in Mississippi. “I don’t limit myself to just one genre. I try not to set boundaries to my imagination. Instead, I follow it just to see where it takes me.
